title: Pet Hair Dryer With Slicker Brush Low Noise 600W 3 Temperature Adjustable 3 In 1 Grooming Dog Blow Dryer For Cats Coffee
body_html: 1、3 in 1 Design: The pet hair dryer brush combines blow drying, brushing, and deshedding functions, making pet grooming more efficient. It's ideal for busy pet owners looking to save time and effort in their grooming routine. 2、Powerful Airflow: Equipped with a high power electric motor, this pet grooming hair dryer brush quickly dries your pet's fur while reducing tangles and static, making the grooming process smooth and enjoyable for both you and your pet. 3、Temperature Control Protection: Featuring built in temperature control technology, this dog hair dryer brush ensures safe hot air output that won’t harm your pet’s skin, making it suitable for various hair types without worry. 4、Easy to Clean: The detachable bristles design makes it easy to clean out hair, preventing buildup and keeping the device hygienic.
